mechanism.claim: When completed Binance spot returns predict the next perpetual minute more strongly than perpetual returns predict the next spot minute, cash price discovery is leading leverage. During elevated variation, a fresh extreme spot-lead state with final-hour venue agreement should relay in that common direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed final-hour spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSPSTL counts categorical sign-transition hits; HVSPER fits level-spread error correction; HVSCTBA estimates same-minute sign-conditioned betas; spot flow and first-passage candidates use volume or barrier timing. HVSPCL uses the difference between two directed lag-one Pearson correlations of continuous open-to-close minute returns, with no level, sign discretization, flow, volume, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly false-to-true continuous cash-leadership onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 360 exact aligned unique coherent BTCUSDT spot and perpetual one-minute rows [D-6h,D)
features.minute_return: log(close/open) independently by venue for each completed minute
features.correlation_validity: all four paired vectors finite with strict positive sample variance; no imputation
features.leadership_advantage: spot_leads_perpetual minus perpetual_leads_spot, finite strict positive
features.leadership_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2160 earlier source-valid positive advantages, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.perpetual_variation: sqrt(sum squared 360 perpetual minute returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over the same 2160/1440 source-valid history, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.final_hour_returns: sum of final 60 completed minute returns independently by venue
features.direction_confirmation: both final-hour returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.eligible_state: leadership and variation ranks pass with direction confirmation
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid hourly decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed six-hour paths are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent continuous directed cross-venue price-discovery mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, return definition, window, lag, correlation, rank, variation, confirmation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
